The '''ALT-25''' was a [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]] model manufactured by [[BlasTech Industries/Legends|BlasTech Industries]] before the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. It features included a magnetic adhesion grip and side-mounted [[Rangefinder/Legends|rangefinder]]. One such pistol was owned by [[Corso Riggs]], who gave it the name "[[Torchy]]," like he did to all of his weapons.<ref name="Torchy" />
